title: Expose the shared reroll assessment in typed status and admission causes
outcome: Expose the shared reroll assessment in typed status and admission causes
acceptance: One core reroll assessment is used by show/next status and the authoritative record-time guard. A standing refusal exposes reroll with kind reroll, mismatch blocking_evaluation_stands, the evaluation record id, typed run-feed identity, exclusive after_position and inclusive through_position, the first blocking criterion/verdict, and remedy record_new_evidence_then_evaluate. The admission error carries the same deciding context as a typed cause distinct from other acceptance_evaluation_refused causes; hosts branch on fields, not prose.

Core and transport tests preserve existing reroll semantics: fail/insufficient_evidence/needs_human block without qualifying evidence; no evaluation/current passing evaluation permits this guard; evidence is assessed only on the selected run in (after_position, through_position]. Contract/binding changes preserve carried-failure rules. Tests distinguish qualifying notes/gates/host evidence and changed or accounted source observations from bookkeeping, same-source/quiet/off-root/unaccounted observations. The record transaction repeats the assessment, so an earlier permissive status is never an admission token. A regression reads a standing refusal, appends qualifying evidence, then records successfully; a complementary race may read permit before a newer blocking evaluation and must refuse at record time against the new cut.
